messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-INC-4821 — high 5xx spike in eu-west-az3 (inference-runtime). Auto-page to oncall

pagerduty-bot: Notification sent to simon (oncall) and maya (sre). Escalation policy: az-outage-critical -> next in 5m if unacked

simon (oncall): acked. looking

maya (sre): on it. grabbing logs now, @lee can you start checking node health in az3?

lee (infra): checking GPU hosts in eu-west-az3. running: `ssh infra-proxy 'kubectl -n inference get pods -o wide --selector=zone=az3'`

olivia (eng): seeing increased tail-latency and 502s in the fronting gateway for requests routed to model-redwood-ggml. Headline: prefix cache misses spike.

maya (sre): stack trace shows `redis-prefix-cache` connection errors during the window. Could be network blips to redis cluster replica in az3.

lee (infra): confirmed - multiple redis pods in az3 are in CrashLoopBackOff with `OOMKilled` and disk pressure on the node. Node metrics show sustained 96% disk usage.

olivia (eng): raising the priority of fallback routing. Recommend switching traffic away from az3 to az1/az2 for read-only inference replicas.

incident-bot: Action suggested by runbook: `AZ capacity / fallback -> start regional failover`. Steps: 1) reduce new sessions to az3 2) reroute 40% traffic to eu-west-az1 3) scale redis replicas in az1 4) notify customers if SLA at risk

maya (sre): simon + lee, agree. simon, want me to do the routing change?

simon (oncall): yes please. maya take lead on routing. lee focus on node eviction/draining and disk cleanups. olivia hold evals for model variance during fallback.

maya (sre): executing sticky config change: `infractl routing set --region eu-west --exclude-az az3 --weight az1=60 az2=40`

pagerduty-bot: simon (oncall) acknowledged the incident. Escalation timer reset.

maya (sre): executed. waiting for propagation (global route control). 

olivia (eng): traffic shift observed in telemetry: az3 request rate down ~65% in last 30s. Error rate in az3 dropping but still elevated for existing sessions. New sessions go to az1/az2.

lee (infra): performing node remediation. Running disk trim and clearing large logs on affected nodes. `ssh node-az3-07 'sudo journalctl --vacuum-time=2d && sudo rm -rf /var/log/old-archive/*.tar'`

ea (eva?), oops wrong name — eva (rotations): forwarding to next oncall for handoff in 25m. simon, you'll need to hand off to tony in 25m.

simon (oncall): noted. preparing 1-2min summary for handoff.

tony (support): looping in support: prep customer comms draft if SLA impacted. Draft below: 
```
Subject: Temporary degradation in eu-west region
Body: We experienced increased error rates affecting inference requests routed to one availability zone (eu-west-az3). Traffic has been rerouted to other AZs and the majority of requests are unaffected. We're continuing remediation; we'll update once all services are healthy.
```

maya (sre): quick customer impact snapshot: ~3% of total requests saw 5xx between 13:12-13:22 UTC, concentrated on E2 and E3 workloads in eu-west. No data loss.

olivia (eng): performing model-level health checks for canary responses in az1/az2 to ensure parity. `python infra/tools/canary_check.py --region eu-west --models all` -> all canaries green except minor latency bump on lourde-7b (~60ms extra).

lee (infra): nodes in az3 now stable after cleanup, redis pods restarting and becoming Ready. Disk pressure relieved to 45%.

maya (sre): re-enable small bleed of traffic back to az3 (10%) to let warm KV caches rebuild. `infractl routing adjust --region eu-west --az az3=10`

pagerduty-bot: Alert PD-INC-4821 status: acknowledged -> monitoring. No escalation pending.

simon (oncall): good work. timeline for postmortem? let's capture root cause: disk pressure causing redis OOM -> 5xx ripple -> failed auto-scaling? Also check why eviction thresholds didn't proactively drain.

tony (support): customers notified via status.redwoody.com incident-1812 draft posted. I'll monitor incoming tickets and summarize top affected customers.

maya (sre): moving to monitoring state. will collect logs and create incident ticket. assigning to `inc-2026-euw-az3-diskpressure` for triage.

olivia (eng): note for postmortem: the model serving runtime did not gracefully fallback to kv cache miss path; add regression test for multi-az cache outage.

eva (rotations): handoff in 25m to tony. simon, please post 1-line update at handoff: status, mitigations, next steps.

simon (oncall): 1-line for handoff: "Mitigated: traffic rerouted off az3, redis restarted, nodes cleaned; monitoring for recurrence; support drafting customer comms."

maya (sre): closing active pager for now but keeping incident thread open for artifacts. Will add logs and timeline to ticket within the hour. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident PD-INC-4821 -> status: monitoring. If error rate > 1% in any AZ for 5m, auto-page will fire again.

tony (support): thanks team. I'll be on deck for next 3 hours.

lee (infra): adding temporary automation to alert on node disk usage >80% so we catch earlier. `alertman add --name disk-pressure-eu-west-az --expr 'node_filesystem_avail_percent < 20' --duration 5m`

olivia (eng): adding a canary that simulates cache misses and validates graceful fallback. PR drafted: https://git.redwood.dev/r/inference/patches/2456

maya (sre): end of thread update: incident moved to monitoring, no major customer outages, partial impact window 10min. Postmortem assigned.

---
Note: logs and runbook links attached to ticket `inc-2026-euw-az3-diskpressure` in the incident tracker.
